Stand next to the ripe crop and [right-click it](https://steamcommunity.com/app/413150/discussions/0/1849197902668085831/#c1849197902669410411). Keyboard [X is mapped to the same Check/Do Action](https://stardewvalleywiki.com/index.php?title=Controls&oldid=192481) as right-click

A standard [scythe](https://stardewvalleywiki.com/index.php?title=Scythe&oldid=171696) is required for certain other crops, such as amaranth, kale, and wheat. Right-clicking or pressing X does not harvest them.
[Kale is harvested with a scythe or better](https://stardewvalleywiki.com/index.php?title=Kale&oldid=192520)
[unmilled rice is harvested with a scythe](https://stardewvalleywiki.com/index.php?title=Unmilled_Rice&oldid=194130)

[fiber seeds are harvested with the scythe](https://stardewvalleywiki.com/index.php?title=Fiber_Seeds&oldid=193587). Fiber seeds are a distinct exception: they do not require daily watering to grow, yet still require a scythe when fully grown.

The [iridium scythe](https://stardewvalleywiki.com/index.php?title=Iridium_Scythe&oldid=186836) is the 1.6 Farming Mastery scythe. Within its swing it harvests crops grown on tilled soil, including regular crops.
Harvest a giant crop with any axe. It takes three hits and drops [15 to 21 normal-quality items](https://stardewvalleywiki.com/index.php?title=Crops&oldid=193979#Giant_Crops).
Face the giant crop and strike it three times using your tool button (left-click or C on PC).

[crops must be watered every day for maximum growth](https://stardewvalleywiki.com/index.php?title=Crops&oldid=193979). If unwatered for a day, a crop will not grow, though unwatered crops do not die.
Unwatered days pause growth without killing the plant, delaying maturity by one morning per dry day.

[Green bean, hops, and grape](https://stardewvalleywiki.com/index.php?title=Crops&oldid=193979#Trellis_Crops) grow on a trellis. You cannot walk through a living trellis, so each plant needs a layout that lets you stand on a neighboring tile.
Planting trellises in solid blocks leaves interior plants unreachable for watering and harvesting.

faqItems.question: How do you harvest a regular mature crop by hand on PC?
faqItems.answer: Stand beside the ripe crop and right-click it, or press X. X is mapped to the same Check/Do Action as right-click. A hand harvest does not need a tool swing.

faqItems.question: Which crops need a regular scythe, and how is the 1.6 iridium scythe different?
faqItems.answer: Amaranth, kale, wheat, unmilled rice, and fiber seeds need a scythe. Right-click or X does not harvest them. The iridium scythe is the 1.6 Farming Mastery scythe, and within its swing it harvests crops grown on tilled soil, including regular crops.

faqItems.question: How do you harvest a giant crop?
faqItems.answer: Use any axe. Face the giant crop and strike it three times with the tool button (left-click or C on PC).

faqItems.question: Does a missed watering day delay the harvest?
faqItems.answer: An unwatered day pauses growth and does not kill the crop, so maturity is one morning later for each dry day. Fiber seeds do not need daily watering to grow, but they still need a scythe when fully grown.

faqItems.question: Why do trellis crops need a neighboring standing tile?
faqItems.answer: You cannot walk through a living trellis, so green bean, hops, and grape each need a neighboring tile you can stand on. A solid block leaves the interior plants unreachable.

faqItems.question: 在 PC 上，普通成熟作物怎么徒手收？
faqItems.answer: 站在成熟作物旁边，右键点它，或者按 X。X 和右键映射成同一个 Check/Do Action。用手收，不需要挥工具。

faqItems.question: 哪些作物要用普通镰刀，1.6 的铱镰刀有什么不同？
faqItems.answer: 苋菜、甘蓝菜、小麦、未碾米和纤维种子必须用镰刀收。右键或按 X 都收不下来。铱镰刀是 1.6 耕种精通给的那把镰刀，挥过的范围内能收耕地上长出来的作物，普通作物也包括在内。

faqItems.question: 巨大作物怎么收？
faqItems.answer: 用任意一把斧头。面向巨大作物，用使用工具的键砍三下（PC 上是左键或 C）。

faqItems.question: 漏浇水会推迟成熟吗？
faqItems.answer: 有一天没浇，这一天就不长，但没浇水的作物不会死；每干一天，成熟就晚一个早晨。纤维种子生长不需要每天浇水，但完全长成以后仍然要用镰刀收。

faqItems.question: 棚架作物为什么必须留邻近站位？
faqItems.answer: 活着的棚架走不穿，所以青豆、啤酒花和葡萄每株都要有一格能站在旁边。棚架如果种成实心一块，里面的植株就浇不到，也收不到。
